# Data

GWAS data for OCD was downloaded from :

- The study: Genome-wide analyses identify 30 loci associated with obsessive–compulsive disorder
- The meta-analyzed summary statistics (not including 23andMe data) are available from the Psychiatric Genomics Consortium Download page (<https://www.med.unc.edu/pgc/download-results/>)
- It can be **rendered** into HTML, PDF, and more
- Learn more at: <https://www.nature.com/articles/s41588-025-02189-z#data-availability>
- https://pgc.unc.edu/for-researchers/download-results/


cCRE beds from snATAC seq was downloaded from CATlas:

- The study: A comparative atlas of single-cell chromatin accessibility in the human brain
- CATlas link of cCRE bed files: <https://decoder-genetics.wustl.edu/catlasv1/humanbrain/data/cCREs/subclass/>
- Custom code and scripts used for analysis can be accessed here: <https://github.com/yal054/snATACutils> and <https://github.com/r3fang/SnapATAC>
- Learn more at: <https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10852054/#SM1>

# Installing LDSC

First cloning the python3.9 branch of ldsc github:

```python
git clone -b ldsc39 https://github.com/CBIIT/ldsc.git
```
::: {.callout-warning}
Had to change the conda config from default. 

```python
conda create --name ldsc39 python=3.9
```
Collecting package metadata (current_repodata.json): failed
UnavailableInvalidChannel: HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN 

```python
conda config --remove channels defaults                           
conda config --add channels conda-forge                           
```
:::

After creating environment, we install needed packages.

```python
pip install -r requirements.txt  
```

# Checking GWAS data

## md5checksum
Comparing the string to verify the integrity of data by ensuring that the data has not been altered or corrupted.

## Prepare input file
Create a clean Neff column and a single MAF column. Neff = 2 × Neff_half recovers the true per-SNP effective sample size. MAF = (FRQ_A + FRQ_U) / 2 averages case and control frequencies as a proxy for population MAF.

```bash
zcat daner_OCD_full_wo23andMe_190522.gz | \
awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"}
     NR==1 {print $0, "Neff", "MAF"; next}
     {print $0, 2*$NF, ($6+$7)/2}' | \
gzip > daner_OCD_wo23andMe.prep.gz
```

# LDSC pipeline

## Run munge_sumstats

```bash
python ../../ldsc/munge_sumstats.py \
    --sumstats gwas/daner_OCD_wo23andMe.prep \
    --N-col Neff \
    --snp SNP \
    --a1 A1 \
    --a2 A2 \
    --p P \
    --merge-alleles ldsc_ref/w_hm3.snplist \
    --out daner_OCD_wo23andMe.munged \
    --chunksize 500000
```

## Lifting over the cCRE from hg38 to hg19

```bash
wget https://hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/hg38/liftOver/hg38ToHg19.over.chain.gz
conda install -n [env_name] -c bioconda ucsc-liftover
```
```bash
for bedfile in hg38/*.bed.txt; do
    f=$(basename "$bedfile" .bed.txt)
    liftOver \
        "$bedfile" \
        ../ldsc_ref/hg38ToHg19.over.chain.gz \
        hg19/${f}.hg19.bed \
        hg19/${f}.unmapped.bed
    n_in=$(wc -l < "$bedfile")
    n_mapped=$(wc -l < hg19/${f}.hg19.bed)
    n_unmapped=$(grep -c '^chr' hg19/${f}.unmapped.bed)
    echo "${f}: ${n_in} input, ${n_mapped} mapped, ${n_unmapped} unmapped"
done | tee liftover_summary.tx

for f in hg19/*.hg19.bed; do
    sort -k1,1 -k2,2n "$f" > "${f%.bed}.sorted.bed"
done
```

## Preparing ldsc reference files

```bash
cd ldsc_ref
mkdir -p 1000G_EUR_Phase3_plink
tar -xzvf 1000G_Phase3_plinkfiles.tgz -C 1000G_EUR_Phase3_plink --strip-components=1
mkdir -p weights_hm3_no_MHC
tar -xzvf 1000G_Phase3_weights_hm3_no_MHC.tgz -C weights_hm3_no_MHC --strip-components=1
mkdir -p baseline_v1.2
tar -xzvf 1000G_Phase3_baseline_v1.2_ldscores.tgz -C baseline_v1.2 --strip-components=1
mkdir -p baselineLD_v2.2
tar -xzvf 1000G_Phase3_baselineLD_v2.2_ldscores.tgz -C baselineLD_v2.2 --strip-components=1
```

## Making annotation files

Make sure to have pybedtools installed.
```bash
conda install -c bioconda -c conda-forge pybedtools bedtools
```

```bash
mkdir -p annot
for bedfile in cCRE/hg19/*.hg19.sorted.bed; do
    f=$(basename "$bedfile" .hg19.sorted.bed)
    mkdir -p annot/${f}
    for chr in {1..22}; do
        python ../../ldsc/make_annot.py \
            --bed-file "$bedfile" \
            --bimfile ldsc_ref/1000G_EUR_Phase3_plink/1000G.EUR.QC.${chr}.bim \
            --annot-file annot/${f}/${f}.${chr}.annot.gz
    done
    echo "${f}: done"
done
```

## Doing L2 for a set of cell types

```bash
nohup bash -c '
mkdir -p logs

export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
export MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
export NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1

PRIORITY_CELLTYPES="MSN PVALB SST VIP LAMP5_1 LAMP5_2 SNCG ITL23 ITL5 SUB ASCT MGC"

for f in $PRIORITY_CELLTYPES; do
    mkdir -p annot/${f}

    seq 1 22 | parallel -j 4 --joblog logs/${f}_l2.log \
        python ../../ldsc/ldsc.py \
            --l2 \
            --bfile ldsc_ref/1000G_EUR_Phase3_plink/1000G.EUR.QC.{} \
            --ld-wind-cm 1 \
            --annot annot/${f}/${f}.{}.annot.gz \
            --thin-annot \
            --out annot/${f}/${f}.{}

    echo "${f}: L2 done at $(date)" >> logs/overall_progress.log
done
' > logs/full_l2_run.out 2>&1 &
```


checking all chromosomes of all cell types:
```bash
for f in MSN PVALB SST VIP LAMP5_1 LAMP5_2 ITL23 ITL5 ITL6_1 SUB ASCT MGC OPC SNCG; do
    count=$(ls annot/${f}/${f}.*.l2.ldscore.gz 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    echo "${f}: ${count}/22 chromosomes"
done
```


fixing bug
```bash
sed -i '223s/get_present_chrs(fh, num+1)/get_present_chrs(fh_list[0], num+1)/' /mnt/h/projects/ldsc/ldscore/parse.py
```

Doing --h2:
```bash
mkdir -p results

for f in MSN PVALB SST VIP LAMP5_1 LAMP5_2 ITL23 ITL5 ITL6_1 SUB ASCT MGC OPC SNCG; do

    # baseline v1.2 — for tau p-value / significance
    python ../../ldsc/ldsc.py \
        --h2 gwas/daner_OCD_wo23andMe.munged.sumstats.gz \
        --ref-ld-chr ldsc_ref/baseline_v1.2/baseline.,annot/${f}/${f}. \
        --w-ld-chr ldsc_ref/weights_hm3_no_MHC/weights.hm3_noMHC. \
        --overlap-annot \
        --frqfile-chr ldsc_ref/1000G_Phase3_frq/1000G.EUR.QC. \
        --out results/${f}_baseline_v1.2 \
        --print-coefficients

    # baselineLD v2.2 — for %h2 enrichment magnitude
    python ../../ldsc/ldsc.py \
        --h2 gwas/daner_OCD_wo23andMe.munged.sumstats.gz \
        --ref-ld-chr ldsc_ref/baselineLD_v2.2/baselineLD.,annot/${f}/${f}. \
        --w-ld-chr ldsc_ref/weights_hm3_no_MHC/weights.hm3_noMHC. \
        --overlap-annot \
        --frqfile-chr ldsc_ref/1000G_Phase3_frq/1000G.EUR.QC. \
        --out results/${f}_baselineLD_v2.2 \
        --print-coefficients

    echo "${f}: h2 regression done"
done
```

## Summary table

```bash
echo -e "CellType\tModel\tProp_SNPs\tProp_h2\tEnrichment\tEnrichment_p\tCoef_z" > summary_table.tsv

for f in *_baseline_v1.2.results; do
    ct=$(basename "$f" _baseline_v1.2.results)
    row=$(tail -1 "$f")
    prop_snps=$(echo "$row" | awk -F'\t' '{print $2}')
    prop_h2=$(echo "$row" | awk -F'\t' '{print $3}')
    enrich=$(echo "$row" | awk -F'\t' '{print $5}')
    enrich_p=$(echo "$row" | awk -F'\t' '{print $7}')
    coef_z=$(echo "$row" | awk -F'\t' '{print $10}')
    echo -e "${ct}\tbaseline_v1.2\t${prop_snps}\t${prop_h2}\t${enrich}\t${enrich_p}\t${coef_z}" >> summary_table.tsv
done

for f in *_baselineLD_v2.2.results; do
    ct=$(basename "$f" _baselineLD_v2.2.results)
    row=$(tail -1 "$f")
    prop_snps=$(echo "$row" | awk -F'\t' '{print $2}')
    prop_h2=$(echo "$row" | awk -F'\t' '{print $3}')
    enrich=$(echo "$row" | awk -F'\t' '{print $5}')
    enrich_p=$(echo "$row" | awk -F'\t' '{print $7}')
    coef_z=$(echo "$row" | awk -F'\t' '{print $10}')
    echo -e "${ct}\tbaselineLD_v2.2\t${prop_snps}\t${prop_h2}\t${enrich}\t${enrich_p}\t${coef_z}" >> summary_table.tsv
done
```


Applying Bonferroni correction across the 13 cell types (α = 0.05/13 ≈ 0.0038) to the baselineLD v2.2 enrichment p-values:
Significant: ITL23, ITL5, ITL6_1, LAMP5_1, LAMP5_2, MSN, OPC, PVALB, VIP, SST
Not significant after correction: ASCT, MGC, SNCG, SUB
